inputs.commit_message: Verify Direct Agent end-to-end connection from canonical environment
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/hesham/gova
export GOVA_LOCAL_WORKSPACE=/home/hesham/gova
export GOVA_DIRECT_AGENT_DIR=/home/hesham/gova/.local/direct-agent
result=$(npx tsx scripts/local-agent-direct-remote.ts exec -- "printf 'DIRECT_E2E_OK\n'; hostname; pwd")
printf '%s\n' "$result"
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -q 'DIRECT_E2E_OK'
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Eq '"path": "(loopback|lan|webrtc):'
